title: Novice Mage
personality:
Gil was the pet fish in a mage's house until a spell went sideways and stood him up on two legs.
He took the robe, the hat and the bag of potions and ran. Everything out here is new to him, and he's thrilled about all of it.
fantasy: The fish out of water. Fences with a swordfish, throws whatever bottle comes out of the bag, and chains crowd control until a foe is Beached.
howto: Play: close-range control; fence, throw potions, Beach foes.
Combo: hit one foe with 3 different {secondary} potions in 5s.
Avoid: {dash} as an escape; you can still be hit underground.
silhouette: the floppy polka-dot wizard hat, the swordfish rapier and the potion bag on his hip

lines.dash: Dive into the ground and swim.
lines.lmb: Three rapier thrusts, stepping in. Hold to lunge down a line.
lines.rmb: Throw the next potion from the bag.
lines.x: Surf a tidal wave down a line.

card.loop: Control mage: fence up close, throw the bag's potions, and land three different effects to Beach a foe.
card.dash: Dive into the ground and swim 6m in 0.4s (you can still be hit). Surfacing next to foes knocks them up.
card.passive: Each different potion effect, and a full Tide Lunge, marks a foe. Three different marks within 5s Beach them: stunned 0.75s.
card.rmb: Throw the next potion from the bag (Thunder, Slime, Air, Fire, or a rare Super Zeep) in an arc. Hold to aim further; in the air it drops straight down.
card.e: Spin with the swordfish for up to 2s, then send a waterspout down a line that knocks up. A longer spin makes a bigger spout.
card.x: Surf a tidal wave down a line: it knocks foes up and slows them, and you land with a shield.

weapons.swordfish: Three quick thrusts with the swordfish; every thrust steps you in, and the third slows. Hold for a Tide Lunge down a line; full charge soaks (a splash mark).

passive.name: Fish Out of Water
passive.desc: Each different potion effect (shock, slime, gust, fire, Super Zeep) and a full Tide Lunge (soak) puts a splash mark on the foe it hits. Three different marks within 5s Beach them: stunned 0.75s, then the marks clear. Each foe can be Beached once every 8s.

lmb.desc: Two quick thrusts and a longer lunge with the swordfish. Every thrust steps you forward a little; the third reaches further and slows 30% for 0.5s. Hold to draw back for a Tide Lunge: let go to drive 2 to 5m down a line behind the point, hitting everyone on it for 10 to 22. At full charge the jet soaks them, which counts as a splash mark.

dash.name: Ground Swim
dash.desc: Dive into the ground and swim about 6m in 0.4s, the fin cutting the surface (you can still be hit). Surfacing next to foes (2.2m) knocks them up for 0.5s.

variants.tap: Throw the next potion from the bag in an arc to the cursor (8m at most).
variants.hold: The landing circle shows while you hold, and the throw reaches 50% further.
variants.air: In the air or gliding, the potion drops straight down under you.

e.name: Riptide
e.desc: Spin with the swordfish for up to 2s, hitting everything within 2.2m every 0.25s for rising damage (2 up to 5). Press E again, or spin the full 2s, to send a waterspout toward the cursor: 10 damage and a 1s knockup to every foe in its line. The longer the spin, the wider, longer and faster the spout.

x.name: Tidal Wave
x.desc: Call a wave and surf its crest 14m toward the cursor in 1s; you can't be targeted while you ride it. Every foe it rolls over takes 18, is knocked up for 1s, then slowed 50% for 2s. You land with a 40 shield for 3s.

rank3.sec: the next two potions in the bag show
rank3.kin: the spout pulls foes to its line

tells.half: blue splash marks over the target, one per different effect
tells.full: three splash marks: the next different effect Beaches them; the next potion glows in his hand
tells.dash_spent: a fin cutting the ground, dash pip dark
